read_authorization: Residents can read published resident policies for their own property and work orders for their own unit. Property managers can read work orders only for assigned properties.
write_authorization: For the MVP, residents can create requests only for their own unit. The backend resolves the unit from verified identity.
approval_rules: Bind approval to the authenticated actor, proposal_id, immutable payload hash, and expiry. Any payload change requires fresh approval. Revalidate authorization at execution.
entry_permission_note: Entry permission is separate from approval to create a ticket; ask the resident explicitly.
idempotency: Require an idempotency key scoped to actor and operation. Persist key, payload hash, and result atomically with ticket creation. Same key and payload returns the original result; same key with a changed payload is rejected.
duplicate_rule: Check active work orders for the same unit and category. Show an existing matching issue before proposing a new request. Ask for clarification when it may be a different issue; do not block all same-category requests blindly.
failure_rule: If an operational tool fails, report that status could not be verified. Do not fabricate a lookup result or claim successful creation.
priority_rule: Classify from the applicable published policy and reported facts. Ask for missing facts instead of guessing. Emergency guidance must not wait for approval or successful ticket creation.
